title: ExportPdfResult
description: The PDF written, or a refuse message when the path, layouts, or detail ink is missing. v3: vector pages (lines and real text) from the flat sheets the DWG is written from; vector false means the vector write failed and the page previews were captured as raster pages instead.

vector.description: True for the vector writer, false for the raster fallback.

hatch_fallback.description: Patterned hatches drawn as their boundary because they would not explode.
